inspiration.observed_pattern: TIMESTAMPADD applies a signed calendar interval to a time point and returns a date-time value.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one independently authored month-end scalar projection, isolating TIMESTAMPADD's MariaDB DATETIME result metadata from table setup, multiple units, and NULL propagation.

fixture_notes: One fixed January 31 timestamp and one-month interval isolate both calendar clamping and the returned DATETIME type.
determinism_notes: The scalar timestamp and interval are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
